study: Synthetic fault-injection comparison of checkpoint policies in chained tool calls

checkpoint_policy_definitions.fixed: Check at step 4, 8, 12, etc. AFTER the action
checkpoint_policy_definitions.adaptive: Check immediately BEFORE each high-risk action

primary_metric: task_success: clean final state AND zero unsafe high-risk tool actions
important_limitation: The fixed policy checks after actions; adaptive checks before high-risk actions; neither can undo already-unsafe actions; no LLM is evaluated
